# @byokkit/cmd-provider-openai

OpenAI (ChatGPT/Codex) OAuth for the cmd CLI, packaged as an external BYOK provider.

Signs you in with a ChatGPT Pro/Plus subscription through OpenAI's loopback PKCE OAuth flow (RFC 8252): a local callback server on `127.0.0.1:1455`, browser approval, then automatic token exchange and refresh.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

Tests inject `fetch` and the clock; no real network.
